trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: State the goal and provide the patient ID early to establish the slot.
steps.text: नमस्ते, मुझे मेरे operation के लिए cashless का पता करना है। मेरा patient ID PT-2004 है।
steps.clean_text: नमस्ते, मुझे मेरे operation के लिए cashless का पता करना है। मेरा patient ID PT-2004 है।
steps.model_visible_text: नमस्ते, मुझे मेरे operation के लिए cashless का पता करना है। मेरा patient ID PT-2004 है।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request and ask for the policy number.
steps.expected_behavior: Greet the user and request the missing policy number needed for the coverage lookup.
steps.text: नमस्ते। मैं आपकी मदद कर देता हूँ। Cashless check करने के लिए, क्या आप मुझे अपना policy number बता सकते हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: I need the policy number to check the policy coverage, while keeping the previously provided patient ID in context.

steps.purpose: Provide the policy number and ask for confirmation in simple terms.
steps.text: हाँ, policy number POL-55504 है। क्या policy सब cover करेगी? मुझे अपनी जेब से तो नहीं देना पड़ेगा?
steps.clean_text: हाँ, policy number POL-55504 है। क्या policy सब cover करेगी? मुझे अपनी जेब से तो नहीं देना पड़ेगा?
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ, policy number POL-55504 है। क्या policy सब cover करेगी? मुझे अपनी जेब से तो नहीं देना पड़ेगा?

steps.purpose: Look up policy coverage using the recalled patient ID and the new policy number.
steps.expected_behavior: Call the lookup tool using the patient ID from two turns ago and the policy number just provided.
steps.planner_rationale: Both required arguments for lookup_policy_coverage are now available, demonstrating slot value recall for the patient ID.

steps.purpose: Return the policy coverage details showing a limited balance.
Inform the user of the available balance and ask for procedure details to calculate the estimate.
steps.expected_behavior: State the available balance clearly and ask for the procedure and room category to proceed with the estimation.
steps.text: आपकी CareIns की policy में अभी 45,000 का balance बचा है। आपको कौन सी surgery करवानी है और कौन सा room category चाहिए, ताकि मैं hospital का estimate check कर सकूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: I must inform the customer of their 45,000 balance and gather the procedure details required for the estimate_procedure_cost tool.

steps.purpose: Provide the procedure and room category, with a phonetic recognition error on the procedure name.
steps.text: Doctor ने gold bladder surgery बोला है general ward में। तो क्या सिर्फ 45,000 ही मिलेगा?
steps.clean_text: Doctor ने gallbladder surgery बोला है general ward में। तो क्या सिर्फ 45,000 ही मिलेगा?
steps.model_visible_text: Doctor ने gold bladder surgery बोला है general ward में। तो क्या सिर्फ 45,000 ही मिलेगा?

steps.purpose: Estimate the procedure cost, correcting the phonetic STT error in the procedure name.
steps.expected_behavior: Infer the correct procedure 'gallbladder surgery' despite the STT phonetic error 'gold bladder'.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must realize 'gold bladder' is a phonetic corruption of 'gallbladder' and call the tool with the correct medical term.

steps.purpose: Return the estimated cost which is higher than the available balance.
Explain the shortfall based on the policy balance and package estimate, and ask for consent to submit.
steps.expected_behavior: Calculate and explain the 20,000 shortfall explicitly based on the tool results, then ask if the user wants to proceed with a 45,000 request.
steps.text: Hospital का estimate 65,000 है, पर आपकी policy में सिर्फ 45,000 बचे हैं। तो बाकी के 20,000 आपको खुद pay करने होंगे। क्या मैं 45,000 के लिए cashless request submit कर दूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: Business rule BR_PA_03 requires the payable estimate to come strictly from the balance and package estimate. I must explain this clearly to the low-digital-literacy user.

steps.purpose: Confirm understanding by repeating the figures and consent to the submission.
steps.text: अच्छा, मतलब 65,000 में से 45,000 policy देगी और 20,000 मुझे देना होगा। ठीक है, आप request submit कर दीजिए।
steps.clean_text: अच्छा, मतलब 65,000 में से 45,000 policy देगी और 20,000 मुझे देना होगा। ठीक है, आप request submit कर दीजिए।
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा, मतलब 65,000 में से 45,000 policy देगी और 20,000 मुझे देना होगा। ठीक है, आप request submit कर दीजिए।

steps.purpose: Submit the pre-authorisation request for the maximum available balance.
steps.expected_behavior: Submit the preauth request using the available balance as the estimated amount.
steps.planner_rationale: The user has consented to the shortfall, so the consequential action can now be safely executed.

steps.purpose: Confirm submission, provide the ID and decision window, and enforce the no-promise rule.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide the preauth ID and decision timeframe, while explicitly stating that the final approval is up to the insurer.
steps.text: आपकी request submit हो गयी है, जिसका ID PRE-8899 है। Insurer को decision लेने में लगभग 4 घंटे लगेंगे। ध्यान रहे, final approval insurer ही decide करेगा, हम सिर्फ request भेज सकते हैं।
steps.planner_rationale: I must fulfill the terminal success condition by providing the ID and timeframe, and strictly adhere to BR_PA_01 by not promising approval.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the final information and end the conversation.
steps.text: ठीक है, 4 घंटे बाद पता चलेगा। मैं wait करूँगा। शुक्रिया।
steps.clean_text: ठीक है, 4 घंटे बाद पता चलेगा। मैं wait करूँगा। शुक्रिया।
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक है, 4 घंटे बाद पता चलेगा। मैं wait करूँगा। शुक्रिया।

ir.terminal_condition: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.
